record.name: Lebanon
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The ministry's draft AI strategy proposes an AI Evaluation Office for sensitive-domain deployment and an AI Security and Red-Team Lab. The draft does not specify the lab's technical remit.

check.language_note: The recorded ar queries use a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. The additional status review used Arabic and English searches. The decisive ministry document was retrieved in English; no Arabic government original for the institutional proposals was located. Search batches for the additional status review, using 1-based positions in check.searches: 3, 4; 5; 6. Each group records the same exact registered URLs found in its combined search results, without attribution to an individual query. Explicit page opens and finds and unverified URL variants are excluded. Groups list the recorded queries; some requests also contained additional queries retained in the research evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The readable ministry draft distinguishes sensitive-deployment evaluation from its separately named security and red-team lab; the latter's technical remit is unspecified. The ministry describes proposals for discussion; formal consultation or submission has not been verified.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of State for Technology and Artificial Intelligence (MITAI/OMSITAI)
related_bodies.role: It leads the national digital transformation and AI strategy; its earlier five-year LEAP plan covers 2025-2030.

related_bodies.name: Lebanese Digital and AI Agency (LEDAIA, proposed)
related_bodies.role: It is proposed in the 2032 strategy as its 'executive engine', carrying delivery and technical oversight.

related_bodies.name: Lebanon AI Evaluation Office (proposed)
related_bodies.role: It is proposed in the ministry's 2032 draft strategy to independently assess whether AI systems are fit for sensitive-domain deployment, reporting to the AI National Council. This deployment-assurance role does not by itself establish evaluation of advanced models for capabilities or behaviour risks.

related_bodies.name: Cybersecurity Institute with an AI Security and Red-Team Lab (proposed)
related_bodies.role: The ministry's draft strategy lists an AI Security and Red-Team Lab within the Cybersecurity Institute's cybersecurity and digital-trust programme. The lab's technical remit is not specified; a qualifying mandate to evaluate advanced models remains unresolved.

related_bodies.name: AI National Council (proposed)
related_bodies.role: It would sign off a quarterly scoreboard as an oversight body comprising private sector, diaspora, university and civil society members.

record.notes: The ministry's strategy draft describes the Evaluation Office as assessing whether AI systems are fit for sensitive-domain deployment. Its cybersecurity programme also names an AI Security and Red-Team Lab, but does not set out that lab's technical remit. The earlier statement that neither body evaluates advanced models was too categorical. The draft labels its initiatives and entities as proposals for discussion, subject to ministries' agreement, rather than agreed commitments. A qualifying remit and evidence of formal consultation or submission would be needed for proposed status; this working draft alone would support at most exploring. Arabic and English searches found no later official adoption or clarified model-evaluation mandate. The ministry's web pages returned empty shells and their single rendered fallbacks failed; the full English PDF was readable.

next_check.reason: Check whether the ministry draft enters formal consultation or submission and whether either body gains a stated model-level remit.
